# Mithila Games

> Independent video game development studio & real-time 3D pipeline tooling laboratory.

Mithila Games is an independent game development studio creating mechanics-first video games, Blender pipeline addons, CC0 shaders, and real-time graphics tools. Founded by Divyanshu Priyadarshi, the studio develops browser-playable HTML5 games, PC titles, and mobile simulations using the Godot Engine and Blender.

## Shipped & In-Development Games

- [T R L](https://mithilagames.com/games.html?item=game-t-r-l): Fast momentum 3D parkour platformer with kinetic wall-running and obstacle courses, playable in-browser via HTML5 and PC.
- [Wings of Paper](https://mithilagames.com/games.html?item=game-wings-of-paper): Relaxing endless 3D origami plane flight simulator with aerodynamic lift mechanics across an open low-poly world (Android / PC).
- [aam chor](https://mithilagames.com/games.html?item=game-aam-chor): 3D survival horror game jam prototype about collecting mangoes with flashlight battery management in a dark forest (HTML5, Windows, Linux).
- [DepthDrive](https://mithilagames.com/games.html?item=game-depth-drive): Cozy casual vehicle physics driving prototype (Android).
- [Bullet Balast](https://mithilagames.com/games.html?item=game-bullet-balast): Hypercasual reflex arcade game with an endless obstacle loop (HTML5, Mobile).
- [WhaDark](https://mithilagames.com/games.html?item=game-whadark): Challenging vertical 2D platforming summit adventure (Android / Linux).
- [Off Goal](https://mithilagames.com/games.html?item=game-off-goal): Solitary minimalist golf adventure in procedurally generated atmospheric worlds (HTML5).

## 3D Tools & Pipeline Addons

- [Haircards Addon for Blender](https://mithilagames.com/store.html?item=haircards): Procedural tool generating game-ready hair card geometry from particle strand systems in Blender.
- [Vertex Shadow Painter for Blender](https://mithilagames.com/store.html?item=vertex-shadow-painter): Baker and custom color utility injecting stylized ambient occlusion directly into vertex channels for low-draw-call rendering.
- [Lowpoly Characters Pack](https://mithilagames.com/store.html?item=lowpoly-character): 4 fully rigged, game-ready casual stylized 3D human models for prototyping.
- [Lowpoly Environment Pack](https://mithilagames.com/store.html?item=lowpoly-environment): 40+ modular low-poly nature and architectural modular assets.
